title: AI Browser Game Jam 5: Oct 16 to Oct 30 - Use any AI tools, 126 entries last round!
author: Slackluster
selftext:
AI Browser Game Jam 5 is open for sign-ups. The jam runs **October 16 to October 30, 2026**.

The rules are simple: make a free browser-playable game in two weeks using AI for whatever you want - code, art, music, design, sound, anything.

**A few details:**

* No sponsor or required AI service
* Solo devs or teams
* Theme revealed when the jam starts
* Theme is optional
* Sharing your AI workflow/process is encouraged
* Participants play and rate the entries

The last jam had **126 entries and 248 people joined**, so I’m really curious how big round 5 gets.

Jam page: [https://itch.io/jam/ai-jam-5](https://itch.io/jam/ai-jam-5)

Discord: [https://discord.gg/86xBnZqHjy](https://discord.gg/86xBnZqHjy)

If you joined one of the previous jams, feel free to share what you made and what tools you used. Thanks for reading and have nice day.

comments.author: Significant-Neck-520
comments.body: Are people building teams for this? Working solo on my AI projects, I'm curious about how a team of AIs would work on a project.
